paragraphs.text: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Monthly membership costs £29. Members can bring a friend free of charge once a month. Personal trainers are available at extra cost.
Indoor pool, sauna and gym, open 6 am to 10 pm. We offer annual membership only, from £420. Free parking for members. Children’s swimming lessons on Saturday mornings.
A small, friendly gym for women only, open 7 am to 9 pm. There is no joining fee, and yoga and pilates classes are included in the monthly price of £35.
Specialist equipment for weightlifting, open 8 am to 11 pm. Pay per visit (£6) or monthly (£40). Showers and lockers available. Students receive a 20% discount with a valid card.

A council-run centre with a gym, sports hall and running track, open 7 am to 10 pm. Monthly membership is £22, with reduced prices for people over 60. Introduction sessions for new members every Tuesday.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the five gyms, A–E. Which gym mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–E.
